_help: Photo uploads to Etsy. Put a listing's photos in etsy-photos/<folder>/ named 1_hero.jpg, 2_product.jpg … (Etsy order), add a job here, then Actions → Upload Etsy photos (dry run first). replaceAll makes the folder's photos the listing's only photos. Finished jobs are marked done.

jobs.note: Photos added by hand on Etsy; used to test the connection (dry run).
